articles.title: IMF confirms El Salvador’s bitcoin growth was funded by private donations, not public money
articles.snippet: The IMF confirmed that all bitcoin added to official holdings since June 2025 was sourced from private donations, with no public funds used for accumulation.

articles.title: OpenAI puts $1 billion behind cyber defense after unveiling AI that can find zero-days
articles.snippet: The company is subsidizing access to its Daybreak security platform after saying Astra can independently find previously unknown software flaws and turn them into working attacks.

articles.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
articles.snippet: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.

articles.title: El Salvador’s post-review Bitcoin accumulation used no public funds: IMF
articles.snippet: The IMF attributed Bitcoin added since June 2025 to private donations, addressing questions raised after El Salvador reported a $100 million acquisition.

articles.title: VARA, Securitize sign MoU for tokenization innovation in Dubai
articles.snippet: VARA and Securitize signed an MoU to foster more tokenization innovation in Dubai and explore how tokenized financial innovation should be regulated in the region.
